title: Ezra beautifies the Temple
summary: Jones dates Ezra beautifying the Temple in the seventh year of Artaxerxes.
description: Jones dates Ezra beautifying the Temple in the seventh year of Artaxerxes. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed. Kevin ruled (2026-10-27) that this is not ezra-returns-to-jerusalem. That return keeps its own sort.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 467 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: Not applied to ezra-returns-to-jerusalem. Ezra 7:27 is the verse that says the king's heart was moved to beautify the house of the LORD.
